question: In which city was the 2025 Laureus World Sports Awards ceremony held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madrid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2025 Laureus World Sports Awards** ceremony is scheduled to be held in **Madrid**, the capital of **Spain**.
 
• This selection marks a significant milestone as **Madrid** hosts the prestigious event for the **second consecutive year**, following the **25th anniversary** edition held in the city in **April 2024**.
 
• The decision to return to the Spanish capital underscores the city's successful partnership with **Laureus** and its capability to host world-class international sporting celebrations.
 
• The ceremony is expected to take place at iconic locations such as the **Palacio de Cibeles**, which serves as a stunning backdrop for honoring the greatest sporting achievements of the previous year.
 
• The event is supported by the **Community of Madrid** and the **Madrid City Council**, aiming to promote the city as a "Global Capital of Sport."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History of Laureus:** The **Laureus World Sports Awards** were established in **1999** by founding patrons **Daimler** and **Richemont**. The inaugural ceremony took place in **2000** in **Monte Carlo**, where **Nelson Mandela** gave an iconic speech about the power of sport to change the world.
 
• **Award Categories:** The ceremony features several highly coveted categories, including **World Sportsman of the Year**, **World Sportswoman of the Year**, **World Team of the Year**, **World Breakthrough of the Year**, and **World Comeback of the Year**.
 
• **Selection Process:** The winners are determined through a two-step process. First, a **Nominations Panel** of over **1,000 sports journalists** from more than **70 countries** selects the nominees. Then, the members of the **Laureus World Sports Academy**—a group of **69 legendary athletes**—vote by secret ballot to select the winners.
 
• **Host City Legacy:** Before the consecutive hosting by **Madrid** in **2024** and **2025**, other major cities that have hosted the event include **Paris**, **Berlin**, **London**, **Shanghai**, and **Rio de Janeiro**.
 
• **Laureus Sport for Good:** Beyond the awards, the organization operates the **Laureus Sport for Good Foundation**, which currently supports more than **250 programs** in over **40 countries**, using sport to tackle social issues like violence, discrimination, and inequality.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Madrid:** By hosting the **2025** edition, **Madrid** joins a short list of cities that have hosted the event multiple times, reflecting **Spain's** deep sporting culture and its recent successes in global sports like football and tennis.
 
• **Impact:** The **Laureus World Sports Awards** reach an estimated global audience of over **1 billion people** through television and digital media, providing immense visibility to the host city.
 
• **Key Figures:** High-profile figures such as **Raúl González** (Real Madrid legend and Laureus Academy member) often play a central role in bringing the event to **Spain**.
